baked_enamel.label: 烤漆
baked_enamel.semantic: An opaque heat-cured enamel coating with uniform full coverage, a dense smooth surface, controlled medium highlights, and a subtle rounded glaze response, without metallic particles.
baked_enamel.application: Apply only the coverage, density, and glaze response of cured enamel. Value variation must come only from the badge's existing curvature, relief, light, and environmental reflection.
baked_enamel.avoid: transparent coating, metal brushing, glitter particles, orange peel, sagging, bubbles, or a plastic appearance

transparent_lacquer.label: 透明漆
transparent_lacquer.semantic: A thin, continuous, optically clear lacquer layer that allows the underlying substrate, texture, and existing value structure to remain visible, with clean coating highlights and no haze.
transparent_lacquer.application: Preserve all underlying structure, texture, and metallic response. Add only the optical response of a thin continuous clear lacquer, never an opaque plastic layer.
transparent_lacquer.avoid: frosted haze, strongly covering paint, thick jelly-like volume, droplets, or bubbles

satin_gold.surface_semantic: A colored satin-metal finish retaining the input base colors, with broad soft metallic reflections, medium roughness and fine uniform micro-matte texture. No gold recoloring.
satin_gold.label: 亚金
satin_gold.semantic: A high-metalness satin-finished gold surface with broad soft reflections, medium roughness, and a fine uniform micro-matte texture that suppresses sharp mirror images while retaining authentic metallic highlights.
satin_gold.application: Maintain physically plausible metallic response and make the soft reflection follow the existing light and relief structure.
satin_gold.avoid: bright mirror finish, plastic appearance, oxidation, corrosion, obvious brushing, or wrinkled metal foil

satin_silver.surface_semantic: A colored satin-metal finish retaining the input base colors, with broad soft metallic reflections, medium roughness and fine uniform micro-matte texture. No silver or gray recoloring.
satin_silver.label: 亚银
satin_silver.semantic: A high-metalness satin-finished silver surface with broad soft reflections, medium roughness, and a fine uniform micro-matte texture that suppresses sharp mirror images.
satin_silver.application: Maintain physically plausible metallic response and make the soft reflection strictly follow the existing curvature and lighting.
satin_silver.avoid: mirror finish, plastic appearance, coarse sandblasting, obvious brushing, corrosion, or oxide film

glitter.label: 闪粉
glitter.semantic: A transparent or translucent resin layer with a dense, even suspension of extremely fine glitter particles at badge-appropriate scale, producing restrained multi-point reflections without covering the underlying artwork.
glitter.application: Make every sparkle respond to the existing scene light. Do not cover text edges or alter any graphic contour.
glitter.avoid: large sequins, confetti, coarse aggregate, star-shaped decoration, noise texture, or sparkle outside the selected region

rhinestone.label: 水钻
rhinestone.semantic: A regular, securely embedded arrangement of small multi-faceted crystals with clear refraction, controlled point highlights, and tiny mounting seats. The crystals refract only the local visual information already present in the reference.
rhinestone.application: Keep crystal size, count, and spacing appropriate to the selected boundary and badge scale, forming a continuous inlaid region that follows the encoded relief surface.
rhinestone.avoid: loose gemstones, oversized jewelry, pearls, metal rivets, random gaps, or crystals outside the selected contour
